Sam: Quick audit on adaptive batch token limits across GPUs (A10/T4/L4/A100/H100). Ran profiler + long-tail load replay. Findings below.

Nisha: thanks — can you paste the peak batch stats?

Sam: Sure. Key observations:
- A10: stable with max_tokens_per_batch=200k, 95th latency within SLO
- T4: saturates at smaller batches when seq>1k; use max_tokens_per_batch=120k
- L4: very efficient single-stream fp16 kernels, can handle 250k tokens but KV hit rate drops; recommend 200k
- A100: handles 512k but kernel_selector sometimes picks slow fused path for small heads; set 400k
- H100: observed a regression: fused attention path regressed ~12% p95 compared to older kernel; temporary safer cap 384k

Devin: can you paste the profiler snippet for H100 regression?

Sam: paste:
```
[profile] model: gpt-medium
kernel_selector: auto -> picked: fused_attn_v2
latency_p95: baseline=48ms -> current=53.8ms (+12.1%)
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.88 -> 0.87
notes: regression correlated with seq_len=2048 and batch_tokens>300k
```

Aaron: ugh. Have we tried forcing non-fused kernel as a canary?

Sam: Yes, forced `kernel_selector=baseline` on one node pool. Results: p95 dropped to 47.9ms but throughput down 8% at high-concurrency. Tradeoff looks like latency vs throughput.

Nisha: So plan?

Sam: Proposal:
1) Immediate: set per-GPU safe caps in runtime config
   - A10: 200000
   - T4: 120000
   - L4: 200000
   - A100: 400000
   - H100: 384000
2) Canary: route 5% traffic on H100 to `kernel_selector=baseline` nodes for 48h
3) Telemetry: add a regression alert for p95+kv_drop and kernel change
4) Longer term: update kernel_selector to prefer baseline when seq_len>1024 and batch_tokens>300k for H100 until fused fix

infra-bot: deploy plan uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/deploys/18345 :white_check_mark:

Devin: One more: queue policy tweak. If queue wait > 12ms and estimated batch_tokens>cap, flush early. That prevents pathological build-ups.

Sam: Good call. I'll add `queue_flush_threshold_ms=12` for H100 pool in the canary.

Aaron: Also add a metric: batch_drop_rate and kv_cache_effective_size per GPU.

Sam: Will do. I'll open a follow-up PR with the runtime config and canary runbook. Thanks.

Nisha: Thanks Sam. :thumbsup:
